# MathJax 3.2.2

Unmodified es5/tex-svg.js distribution component from the official MathJax
repository, pinned to tag 3.2.2.

Source: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax/blob/3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js

The original Apache 2.0 license is included in LICENSE. SVG glyphs are
bundled in the component, so the site does not need an external font CDN.
